description: This file defines a React component 'ConnectorsTable' which displays a table of connectors, manages its loading and error states, and allows triggering synchronization actions for each connector via API calls.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the list of connectors from the API and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: triggerSync
methods.description: Triggers synchronization for a specific connector by its ID through the API and refreshes the list after success.
